files.name: class-server.js
files.content:
// The class Share server. The deployed worker address goes here once, and every projector page and phone page in class-11 reads it. Open a projector page with ?shareHost=https://your-server.workers.dev on the end of its address to use a different server for one run.
window.CLASS_SHARE_HOST = 'https://p5-phone-share.npuckett.workers.dev';

files.name: index.html
files.content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>03 Hot Potato: Phone</title>
  <style>
    body {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #141414;
    }
    canvas {
      touch-action: none; /* a finger on the canvas never scrolls the page */
    }
  </style>

  <!-- a laptop sends one empty tilt reading. this drops it before p5 sees it -->
  <script>window.addEventListener('deviceorientation', function (e) { if (e.beta === null) e.stopImmediatePropagation(); }, true);</script>

  <!-- the class server address. the projector's code carries its own, so a phone needs no setup -->
  <script src="class-server.js"></script>

  <!-- p5.js 2.x -->
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/p5@2.2.3/lib/p5.js"></script>
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/p5.js-compatibility@0.2.0/src/preload.js"></script>

  <!-- p5-phone: shake, vibration and Share -->
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/p5-phone@1.15.4/dist/p5-phone.min.js"></script>

  <!-- keeps the screen awake and stands in for the phone on a laptop -->
  <script src="phone-kit.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
  <script src="sketch.js"></script>
</body>
</html>
